title: Le Petit Chef - Atlanta
specs: Culinary world tour through Spain, Italy, France, and Japan
Vote for your favourite chef and winner revealed
blurb: Le Petit Chef presents a 3D cinema directly on your plate combined with excellent gastronomy. The dinner show features a culinary world tour through Spain, Italy, France, and Japan with four courses. Guests vote for their favorite chef at the end of the evening.
extraNote: Parking for $5 with validation or complimentary self-parking · Cassis at Grand Hyatt Atlanta in Buckhead

quotes.text: We had such a wonderful experience! The 3D projection was creative, fun, and truly impressive, it made the whole dining experience so special. Both adults and kids were amazed and had a great time. Each dish was exciting, beautifully presented, and full of surprises. We would definitely recommend this to everyone who's looking for something unique and memorable!
